tasks.summary: Rechecked the six direct-gauge planning candidates; none can be promoted without fresh provider data or a Stump Lake gauge-applicability decision.

tasks.summary: Reviewed the strongest remaining official Otter Tail candidate; it remains planning-only because its product-supported gauge is a downstream proxy. Minnesota is provisionally saturated under the current policy.

tasks.title: Build the Utah scored-route coverage baseline
tasks.summary: Added a second Utah scored route for the Colorado River Moab Daily / Hittle Bottom to Takeout Beach, with BLM/AW/USGS evidence, camping classification, safety caveats, geometry/coordinate audit path, and a bounded no-image result.

tasks.title: Build the South Dakota scored-route coverage baseline
tasks.summary: Paused the broad South Dakota scored-route baseline after fourteen five-candidate no-add reviews. South Dakota is not exhausted, but repeated cadence work is now blocked by documented source, threshold, access, safety, camping, route-shape, and provider-adapter gaps; resume only after a precise evidence task clears a blocker or a new manager-grade source appears.

tasks.title: Verify Gavins Point release adapter evidence
tasks.summary: Completed narrow adapter/accessibility decision. Official USACE NWDM/CDA exposes machine-readable hourly Gavins Point Flow-Out cfs and Yankton Flow cfs, but PaddleToday currently supports only USGS and MN DNR gauge providers; MNRR 59-mile candidates remain blocked until a USACE/NWDM adapter is implemented and route gates are rerun. The 39-mile Fort Randall reach still needs a separate Fort Randall release-source decision.

tasks.title: Repair Big Sioux route geometry package
tasks.summary: Supervisor validation initially detected a stale canonical geometry count for big-sioux-river-rec-area-south-highway-42, then focused verification found the route geometry asset present and routes:geometries:audit passed at 687/687. No further geometry follow-up is needed.
